problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 5 cargo shipments through 5 specialized customs checkpoints.

Each shipment must pass through a predetermined sequence of checkpoints represented as (Checkpoint, Processing duration) pairs, where each pair specifies the required checkpoint and the time needed for inspection. The sequence of pairs indicates the mandatory order in which the checkpoints must be completed.

Shipment details:
* S1 follows the route: (C4, 8) → (C5, 4) → (C1, 6) → (C2, 5) → (C3, 8)
* S2 follows the route: (C1, 9) → (C2, 10) → (C5, 3) → (C4, 8) → (C3, 7)
* S3 follows the route: (C2, 8) → (C4, 6) → (C5, 9) → (C1, 3) → (C3, 6)
* S4 follows the route: (C4, 1) → (C1, 8) → (C2, 10) → (C5, 8) → (C3, 1)
* S5 follows the route: (C2, 7) → (C3, 8) → (C1, 2) → (C5, 8) → (C4, 4)

Each customs inspection must run continuously once initiated without interruption, and each checkpoint can only process one shipment at a time. The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all shipments at the checkpoints so that the total completion time for all shipments is minimized.
